name: saive
description: Search, read, and save to your Saive bookmark library.

interface.longDescription: Saive keeps the articles you save as portable markdown, each with an AI summary and tags. This plugin brings that library into ChatGPT and Codex. Ask what you've saved about a topic and get an answer that cites your own saves. Pull up an article's full text, or everything you highlighted on a subject. Save a link from the conversation without leaving it. The plugin signs in to your own Saive account, sees only your library, and cannot delete saves or change a folder's sharing. Saves stay private unless you file them in a folder you share.
defaultPrompt: What have I saved about home batteries?
Save this link to my Reading folder
What did I highlight about heat pumps?
